title: Smoky Korean Black Pudding Namul Salad
description: A twist on traditional Thai salads, this dish combines smoky black pudding with spicy Korean flavors and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Cook the black pudding according to package instructions, slicing into thin strips.
In a separate pan, toast the sesame oil over medium-low heat.
Add the sliced red cabbage, grated carrot, and chopped cilantro to the pan, stirring to combine.
Add the cooked black pudding to the pan, stirring to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the fish sauce, lime juice, and chili flakes.
Pour the dressing over the salad, tossing to combine.
Serve immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
